findings.F1: The book's whole gain comes from the heaviest-volume fifth of days. The position's next-day gain is +0.522 % per coin-day there (t 5.27, 2267 cases), against −0.025 % to +0.033 % in the other four fifths (|t| ≤ 1.6). The idea's graded slope adds nothing between light and ordinary volume.
findings.F2: The heavy-volume lean lives on down days. After a down day in its coin's top volume fifth, the next-day excess return is +1.18 % (t 5.33, 1049 cases). The other down-day volume fifths give −0.22 % to +0.39 % (t ≤ 2.0). After up days in the top fifth it is −0.001 % (t 0.00, 1218 cases).
findings.F3: Inside heavy-volume days the rebound grows with the size of the fall. In the coin's largest-fall fifth of days with top-fifth volume, the next-day excess is +1.40 % (t 5.01, 728 cases). In the second-largest-fall fifth it is +0.93 % (t 2.32, 252). On flat-to-rising days with heavy volume it is −0.36 % to +0.26 % (|t| < 1).
findings.F4: Heavy-volume days that close near their low rebound most. They return +1.33 % next day (t 4.91, 641 cases), against +0.69 % for mid closes (t 2.47) and −0.12 % for high closes (t −0.46).
findings.F5: Up days on light-to-ordinary volume drift lower the next day. The bottom three volume fifths give −0.39 %, −0.58 % and −0.61 % (t −2.64, −3.71, −3.85; about 1130 cases each). The top fifth gives 0.00 %. The fall is not graded at the light end, and these t's are not clustered by day.
findings.F6: The heavy-volume rebound is not confined to one trend. On the coin's 20-day trend, the top volume fifth gives +0.61 % when falling (t 1.89), +0.37 % when choppy (t 1.83) and +0.45 % when rising (t 1.67).
findings.F7: The per-case move on heavy-volume down days covers the cost of a trade, unlike the tested idea. Heavy down days give +1.18 % per case against a 0.22 % trade cost, about 5 times the cost. The tested idea's total move is +0.07 % per case, 0.3 times the cost. On the 3-day grid the heavy down days give +1.52 % (t 2.33, 330 cases).

ideas.idea: On a day a coin falls, the heavier its volume against its own average daily volume over the past 20 days, the larger its rise over the next day, in any market.
ideas.consequence: A trader buys a coin's heavy-volume down days in every market, not only falling agitated ones (064-01 already holds that profile), and ignores volume on up days.
ideas.name: heavy volume down day rebound

ideas.idea: On a day a coin rises, the lighter its volume against its own average daily volume over the past 20 days, the larger its fall over the next day.
ideas.consequence: A trader refuses to buy, or leans short, the day after a coin rises on thin volume. The short side is thinly held among strategies acting in every profile.
ideas.name: light volume up day fade
